'''Roustabouts''' were members of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] crew that served in two capacities; as cargo loaders, similar to [[crate-buster]]s, but also as enforcers who protected the crew and fought any enemies that the crew made. Roustabouts were generally former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who signed on with a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crew. [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] made particularly effective roustabouts.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
